This is right. There's an "Edit" button sitting on the row, and when I used it I could change both the title and description; the item now reads "Sunday roast potatoes" with "Reliable crispy potatoes for family dinners." underneath. And the bookmark still opens the real Serious Eats page, so editing didn't get in the way of just clicking through.

The separate, always-visible edit control feels good to me — it makes clear that clicking the item goes to the website while the button is for changing the details, so I won't accidentally open the page when I just meant to tidy up a title.

One thing I want to make sure of, since you mentioned keeping the web address unchanged here: sometimes a link itself is wrong or moves, and I'd want to be able to fix the actual web address of a saved bookmark too, not just its title and description. Can that same edit include changing the address when I need to?
